teams.synopsis: A great performance in Week 7 had the potential to be even better if Tony Pollard was started.
teams.blurb: A great performance in Week 7 had the potential to be even better if Tony Pollard was started. Station Grits take the top spot in this week’s rankings as they lead the league in points per week. The team boasts two top 15 QBs, a top five WR room in the league, two top five TEs, and a few mid-tier RBs. If Baylen is able to turn some of that talent into a star RB or someone of that caliber than the team will be set for the 2026 Playoffs. First up though, he gets an N.Y. Routensss team that has struggled to put up points in recent weeks.

teams.synopsis: Dropping Ben down this week, but don’t worry it’s not back down to 6th this time.
teams.blurb: Dropping Ben down this week, but don’t worry it’s not back down to 6th this time. Despite the mediocre performance in Week 7, Ben earned his 5th win of 2026 and moves to the sole owner of the top spot in the Republican Conference. A$AP Monke is now 3rd in points per week, so the record isn’t fluky. It’s also been a crazy turn around for the franchise these past two seasons, as they were 7-21 from 2023 to 2024 but have since moved to 16-5 since Week 1 of 2025. With an easier matchup in Week 8 against one of the worst teams in the league, and what’s projected to be one of the easiest schedules in the league, I think Ben’s successful regular season continues. If Kyle Pitts Sr. can keep his hot streak going, while Lamar Jackson and Kyle Monangai return from injury, then I think this team will be a weekly top three ranking.

teams.synopsis: A constant in the upper half of these weekly rankings.
teams.blurb: A constant in the upper half of these weekly rankings. I think Charlie deserves the recognition that I’ve been giving him even if the team is only 6th in points per week. They get what’s projected to be an easier matchup in Week 8, I wouldn’t be surprised if the team has a more successful second half of the season, maybe let’s say going 5-2 to finish the year. Charlie doesn’t have as much depth as he did earlier in the season due to injuries, so it’s really now just up to his core QB, two RBs, and two WRs to carry the load, while maybe Chig Okonkwo can get something going for the team’s TE position. May also be worthy to make a note of Jahmyr Gibbs exiting Week 7 with an injury, that would make things very interesting for Charlie in Week 8.

teams.synopsis: The only team in the top nine in this week’s edition of rankings to have a positive record.
teams.blurb: The only team in the top nine in this week’s edition of rankings to have a positive record. In his own words, Aidan’s 2026 campaign can be summed up by “Draft and Pray”, and it has semi-worked out so far. Yes, you’d like the record to be better but the team is 5th in points per week and is projected to win in Week 8. Now, Aidan does lead the league in my created depth metric, so maybe it would beneficial for the manager to make a move or two to bolster their starting lineup, but even without those changes I think the team has a fine case to make a playoff push and be a top contender in 2026. Let’s see how Week 8 goes with a few players back from BYE and a couple now on BYE.

teams.synopsis: Dominated in Week 7, but hopefully that was a one time thing due to BYEs.
teams.blurb: Dominated in Week 7, but hopefully that was a one time thing due to BYEs. In Week 8, Anthony is projected to be in a shootout with Deniz, which is why their matchup is on prime time this week. I think this past week was a fluke for Rolls With Butter and they’ll be right back on track in no time. However, if I were them I’d be worried about A.J. Brown still not being good, his play will determine if this team is top of the league or just a 2nd tier contender in my opinion. Also, keep and eye on Zach Charbonnet, he could be the RB2 that Anthony has been needing for weeks.

teams.synopsis: Quin again put up a great performance, but this time it ended with an unfortunate loss.
teams.blurb: Quin again put up a great performance, but this time it ended with an unfortunate loss. If DeVonta Smith doesn’t suit up in Week 8 then the WR room for The Gegwich Effect is looking BLEAK, especially against what’s projected to be a tough matchup. Quin’s trade last week looks to be a big win early on, especially if Drake Maye and Bijan Robinson continue to play like elite options at their positions. I think there’s room for even more improvement with this team and a playoff push in the 2nd half of the season, but we’ll most likely have to wait until after Week 8 for that to come to fruition.

teams.synopsis: This 2026 season has felt like a roller coaster for me.
teams.blurb: This 2026 season has felt like a roller coaster for me. With a massive win in Week 7, the 4th largest margin of victory of any team in 2026, Ethan has earned a higher spot in the rankings, specifically a top eight ranking. Oh He Likes Cooking! is now 2nd in the league in points per week, but Week 8 doesn’t project to be more of the same. Actually, the team has not won nor lost two games in a row this season so it would be very on brand of them to lose in Week 8 to continue that streak. Anyway, I like my team right now but that could change in an instant, let’s see how serious the Jaylen Waddle injury is.

teams.synopsis: Despite a mediocre performance in Week 7, Max wins his 4th matchup in a row.
teams.blurb: Despite a mediocre performance in Week 7, Max wins his 4th matchup in a row. This was the first time since Week 1 that the team produced more than 101 points. In Week 8, Max is favored to beat Cole so I would expect the team to continue to slowly look better and better and start to match the success with point production. A key point of Max’s success has been his ability to win the waiver wire, currently shown to be one of the best managers in the league in that department in 2026. I’m going to be honest, at full strength the potential is there for this team to put up 120+ consistently but we just haven’t gotten that yet. Maybe in Week 8.

teams.synopsis: Another poor performance in Week 7, but this time Andrew was able to get the win.
teams.blurb: Another poor performance in Week 7, but this time Andrew was able to get the win. However, his Week 8 opponent doesn’t appear to be as easy of a matchup, but Andrew’s players have a plethora of good matchups so we could be in store for a tight high-scoring affair. The team is just trying to stay afloat until Davante Adams comes back, so the current 4-3 record is nice to have. Now, we’re on records watch for a couple of N.Y. Routensss players, including Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce. First, Patrick Mahomes is just six points away from joining the 400+ club for the team, he’d be the 2nd player in N.Y. history to score that many for the ball club, joining Josh Jacobs. Travis Kelce is also only eight points away from becoming the franchise’s top scoring TE, passing Darren Waller at 233 points. Fun storylines.

teams.synopsis: Ryan loses yet another matchup despite putting up a great score.
teams.blurb: Ryan loses yet another matchup despite putting up a great score. Make Fantasy Great Again is 4th in the league in points per week through seven weeks, but they’re tied for the worst record. Hopefully the team can continue to produce but earn a win in Week 8. Unfortunately for Ryan, the team will be on BYE-maggedeon due to the 49ers being off in Week 8. Fortunately for Ryan, Carmine is also dealing with something similar because of the Texans, so I expect the team to still have a good shot to get a win in Week 8. Looking past Week 8, I think this team will have a nice second half to the year and potentially make a playoff push. If they can keep up this production but just get the wins and finish at .500 then they will no doubt make the 2026 Playoffs.

teams.synopsis: Deniz earned a huge win in Week 7 his most points scored in a week in 2026.
teams.blurb: Deniz earned a huge win in Week 7 his most points scored in a week in 2026. This week looks to be yet another high scoring affair for the team, which is why it earns the Week 8 Matchup of the Week title. Is Josh Jacobs back? It looks like it, and if he is then Deniz just found his solution to his RB2 troubles. Now, all that remains as a thorn in Deniz’s side is his FLEX play, but in my opinion Antonio Williams will very comfortably be able to fill that gap in the second half of 2026. Nevertheless, the team has been mediocre and is still below .500, so for now they will have to deal with this low rating.

teams.synopsis: In a similar position to Brandon above, Cole is looking to turn his season around and do a 180 as begin the second half of 2026.
teams.blurb: In a similar position to Brandon above, Cole is looking to turn his season around and do a 180 as begin the second half of 2026. The RB room is maybe the worst in the league, while all other positions are sneakily good enough to contend for a championship. The coming weeks and their success for Cole will depend largely on the RB production, whether that’s via trade or just Jeremiyah Love taking the leap that Cole drafted him to take. It’s projected to be a tough matchup in Week 8, and even tougher the rest of the season with the hardest projected strength of schedule. I think Cole can turn things around, but it’s going to need to happen sooner rather than later.

teams.synopsis: I shouldn’t be moving The Minutemen up, but here we are.
teams.blurb: I shouldn’t be moving The Minutemen up, but here we are. Brandon is one of only three teams this season to be averaging less than 100 points through Week 7, and coupled with his 2-5 record it’s not hard to see why this team deserves this placement. Also, the Jonathan Taylor trade rumors may or may not benefit the team, but in the short term it looks like it may hurt Brandon since he will need his top player to climb out of this 2-5 hole. Getting Rashee Rice back from injury is also much needed for The Minutemen, as right now they don’t really have “that guy” at WR, just a bunch of FLEX-level guys. Speaking of WRs, KC Concepcion may be breaking out after a Week 7 performance where he earned 10 targets and put up 23 fantasy points. Unfortunately for Brandon, he did that while on his bench. Let’s see if the team can turn it around in the second half of the season like they did last year, or maybe they will continue this five game losing streak.

teams.synopsis: I said last week that I have faith in this team to hit their stride in the second half of the season amidst the poor start to the season, but now I don’t know what to think.
teams.blurb: I said last week that I have faith in this team to hit their stride in the second half of the season amidst the poor start to the season, but now I don’t know what to think. After putting up the least amount of points the franchise has ever scored in any given week back in Week 2, the team has scored the 3rd least amount in any given week in Week 7, to go along with the team dropping three straight games while failing to produce any more than 91 points. However, the team may be set up for some success this week due to an weak opponent missing a few key players due to BYE. Carmine is missing a bunch of his own key players too, but if Breece Hall and DJ Moore play this week then he’ll have a chance. By far the worst season to date for Carmine, but we’re only half-way through so anything can happen.

matchup_of_the_week.blurb: Two teams projected to score at least 120 points in Week 8, Anthony has the edge all-time with a 4-2 record against Deniz. Both teams’ Week 7 performances could not have been less alike each other with Anthony putting up 89 points, his 2nd lowest weekly total in 2026, and Deniz putting up 143 points, his highest weekly total in 2026. Both teams at full strength and no BYEs for either side, should be a fun one.
